title: The maximum number of triangles in graphs without vertex disjoint friendship graphs
summary: Given graphs $H$ and $F$, the generalized Turán number $\mathrm{ex}(n,H,F)$ is the maximum number of copies of $H$ among all $n$-vertex $F$-free graphs. The friendship graph $F_k$ consists of $k$ triangles sharing a common vertex. In this paper, we determine the value of $\mathrm{ex}(n,K_3,(t+1)F_k)$, where $K_3$ is a triangle, $t\geq 1$ is an integer, and $(t+1)F_k$ denotes a union of $(t+1)$ pairwise vertex-disjoint copies of $F_k$.
